section.content: 本实用新型公开一种锂离子电池，包括壳体和盖板，壳体包括主体和展开部，主体呈长方体状，主体的一侧面设置有呈矩形的第一开口，展开部包括两个第一面板和两个第二面板，两个第一面板相对设置，两个第二面板相对设置，两个第一面板及两个第二面板的一条边均设置在第一开口上，展开部可聚拢并形成供盖板封盖的第二开口。本实用新型的锂离子电池的壳体具有可聚拢的展开部，相较于常规的电芯入壳时需要与外壳上的开口精确对准，本实施例的壳体允许芯包免去精确定位，展开部可引导芯包进入壳体的主体内，降低了芯包入壳时的难度，由于芯包不会与壳体锋利的边缘部位接触，减小了芯包被壳体挫伤的概率。

The utility model discloses a lithium ion battery, including casing and apron, the casing includes main part and expansion portion, and the main part is the cuboid form, and a side of main part is provided with the first opening that is the rectangle, and expansion portion includes two first panels and two second panels, and two first panels set up relatively, and two second panels set up relatively, and a limit of two first panels and two second panels all sets up on first opening, and expansion portion can gather together and form the second opening that supplies the apron closing cap. The utility model discloses a lithium ion battery's casing has the expansion portion that can gather together, need aim at with the opening accuracy on the shell when going into the shell in traditional electric core relatively, and the casing of this embodiment allows the core package to remove accurate positioning from, and expansion portion can guide the core package and get into in the main part of casing, has reduced the degree of difficulty when the core package goes into the shell, because the core package can not contact with the sharp edge part of casing, has reduced the probability that the core package was contused by the casing.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a technical field is made to the battery, especially relates to a lithium ion battery of shell is gone into to easy core package.

Background

The existing lithium battery comprises two types of winding type core packages and laminated type core packages, and for the lithium battery adopting the winding type core packages, the core packages are easily contused by a shell of the battery in the traditional shell entering process.

In addition, in order to reduce the shake of the core bag in the shell and avoid unnecessary capacity loss, the opening of the shell at present is usually only slightly larger than the size of the core bag, so that the core bag needs to be accurately positioned when entering the shell, and the edge of the shell is prevented from bruising the core bag, so that the difficulty of entering the shell is high.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

An object of the utility model is to provide a lithium ion battery, the expansion portion of its casing can guide the core package to go into the shell before gathering together, and the income shell degree of difficulty of core package is less, is difficult for being contorted by the casing of battery.

To achieve the purpose, the utility model adopts the following technical proposal:

the utility model provides a lithium ion battery, includes casing and apron, the casing includes main part and expansion portion, the main part is the cuboid form, a side of main part is provided with the first opening that is the rectangle, expansion portion includes two first panels and two second panels, two first panel sets up relatively, two the second panel sets up relatively, two first panel and two a limit of second panel all sets up on the first opening, expansion portion can gather together and form the confession the second opening of apron closing cap.

As a preferred embodiment of the present invention, the first opening and the second opening have equal areas, two, the first panel and two, the second panel is rectangular.

As a preferred embodiment of the present invention, the area of the first opening is larger than the area of the second opening, and both the two first panels and the two second panels are trapezoidal;

or, the two first panels are trapezoidal, and the two second panels are rectangular.

As an optimized scheme of the utility model, at least one through-hole has been seted up on the apron, all be provided with in the through-hole and converge the fluid, converge the fluid and be connected with the inside core package electricity of battery, the through-hole both sides all be provided with one with the insulating pad of apron laminating, one side that the through-hole is located the battery inside is provided with the fixed shim, converge fluidic one end and pass two trompil on the insulating pad reaches the through-hole and with the fixed shim is connected.

As a preferred embodiment of the present invention, the size of the opening is smaller than the size of the through hole.

As a preferred embodiment of the present invention, the insulating spacer is bonded to the cover plate.

As a preferred embodiment of the present invention, the fluid collecting body is riveted to the fixing pad.

As an optimized proposal of the utility model, the cover plate or the shell is also provided with a liquid injection hole.

As an optimized proposal of the utility model, a sealing nail is arranged on the liquid injection hole.

As a preferred embodiment of the present invention, the first panel is welded to the second panel.

The utility model has the advantages that:

the utility model discloses a lithium ion battery's casing has the expansion portion that can gather together, need aim at with the opening accuracy on the shell when going into the shell in the conventional electric core relatively, the utility model discloses the casing allows the core package to remove accurate positioning from, and expansion portion can guide in the main part that the core package got into the casing, has reduced the degree of difficulty when the core package goes into the shell, because the core package can not contact with the edge part that the casing is sharp, has reduced the probability that the core package was contused by the casing.

1. a housing; 10. a main body; 11. a first panel; 12. a second panel; 101. a first opening; 102. a second opening; 2. a cover plate; 21. a through hole; 22. a liquid injection hole; 31. a sink fluid; 32. an insulating spacer; 321. opening a hole; 33. fixing a gasket; 4. and (5) sealing the nail.

Detailed Description

The technical solution of the present invention is further explained by the following embodiments with reference to the accompanying drawings.

In the present disclosure, unless expressly stated or limited otherwise, the first feature "on" or "under" the second feature may comprise direct contact between the first and second features, or may comprise contact between the first and second features not directly. Also, the word "over" a first feature or feature in a second feature may include the word "over" or "over" the second feature, or may simply indicate that the first feature is at a higher level than the second feature. A first feature "under" a second feature may include a first feature that is directly under and obliquely under the second feature, or may simply mean that the first feature is at a lesser elevation than the second feature.

Furthermore, the terms "first", "second" and "first" are used for descriptive purposes only and are not to be construed as indicating or implying relative importance or implicitly indicating the number of technical features indicated. Thus, a feature defined as "first" or "second" may explicitly or implicitly include one or more of that feature.

As shown in fig. 1 to 4, the lithium ion battery of the present embodiment includes a housing 1 and a cover plate 2, the housing 1 includes a main body 10 and an expansion portion, the main body 10 is in a rectangular shape, a first opening 101 in a rectangular shape is disposed on a side surface of the main body 10, the expansion portion includes two first panels 11 and two second panels 12, the two first panels 11 are disposed oppositely, the two second panels 12 are disposed oppositely, one edge of each of the two first panels 11 and the two second panels 12 is disposed on the first opening 101, and the expansion portion can be gathered to form a second opening 102 for covering the cover plate 2.

The lithium ion battery's of this embodiment casing 1 has the expansion portion that can gather together, need aim at with the opening accuracy on the shell when going into the shell in the traditional electric core relatively, and the casing 1 of this embodiment allows core package (not shown in the figure) to remove accurate positioning from, and the expansion portion can guide the core package to get into in the main part 10 of casing 1, has reduced the degree of difficulty when the core package goes into the shell, because the core package can not contact with the sharp border position of casing 1, has reduced the probability that the core package was contused by casing 1.

As shown in fig. 3 and 4, it is preferable that the first opening 101 and the second opening 102 have the same area, and the two first panels 11 and the two second panels 12 have a rectangular shape, so that the case 1 maintains the shape of a rectangular parallelepiped after the developed portions are gathered, for manufacturing a square battery. For convenience of illustration, the first panel 11 and the second panel 12 in the figures both present a larger area, and in an actual production process, the areas of the first panel 11 and the second panel 12 may be set to be smaller, and the expansion part can still exert a guiding effect on the core package before being gathered together.

In other embodiments, as shown in fig. 5 and 6, the area of the first opening 101 is larger than that of the second opening 102, and both of the first panels 11 and both of the second panels 12 have a trapezoidal shape. This arrangement also provides a good fit between the edges of the first and second panels 11, 12, and the volume of the housing 1 is relatively small when the flared portions are brought together.

Further, two first panels 11 are trapezoidal, and two second panels 12 are the rectangle, and perhaps two first panels 11 are the rectangle, and two second panels 12 are trapezoidal setting and can realize gathering together of expansion portion equally.

Preferably, the first panel 11 is welded to the second panel 12. First panel 11 and second panel 12 of mode welding that can select for use laser welding, because the core package has gone into the shell during the welding, in order to protect the core package and realize the good sealed of casing 1, need adopt welding methods of high accuracy such as laser welding.

As shown in fig. 1, preferably, two through holes 21 are formed in the cover plate 2, a fluid collecting body 31 is disposed in each through hole 21, the fluid collecting body 31 is electrically connected to a core package (not shown) inside the battery, two sides of each through hole 21 are provided with an insulating gasket 32 attached to the cover plate 2, one side of each through hole 21 inside the battery is provided with a fixing gasket 33, and one end of the fluid collecting body 31 passes through the openings 321 of the two insulating gaskets 32 and the through hole 21 and is connected to the fixing gasket 33. One sink 31 is connected to the positive lugs of the core pack as a positive terminal and the other sink 31 is connected to the negative lugs of the core pack as a negative terminal. The two insulating gaskets 32 isolate the bus bar 31 from the cover plate 2 so as to realize the insulation of the bus bar 31 and the cover plate 2, the fixing gasket 33 is connected with the bus bar 31 so as to fix the bus bar 31, and the rotation of the bus bar 31 can be effectively prevented by the friction force between the fixing gasket 33 and the insulating gasket 32 positioned in the battery.

In other embodiments, only one through hole 21 is provided in the cover plate 2, so that only one fluid-collecting body 31 needs to be provided. In the present embodiment, one pole of the core pack is connected to the bus bar 31, and the other pole of the core pack is connected to the case 1 (the positive tab or the negative tab of the core pack is welded to the case 1), so that the cost of the battery can be further reduced. In addition, an insulating film can be wrapped on part of the surface of the shell 1, so that a specific area of the shell 1 which is not wrapped by the insulating film can serve as a battery terminal, and the situation that the battery is easy to generate short circuit due to the fact that the whole surface of the shell 1 is exposed is prevented.

Further, the size of the opening 321 is smaller than that of the through hole 21, so that the sidewall of the bus bar 31 does not contact with the wall of the through hole 21 to achieve insulation.

In some embodiments, the insulating gasket 32 is bonded to the cover plate 2, and the insulating gasket 32 is pressed against the cover plate 2 by the bus bar 31 or the fixing gasket 33, so that the insulating gasket 32 may be fixed by friction, but if the connection between the bus bar 31 and the fixing gasket 33 is loosened, the insulating gasket 32 may be loosened, and the deviation of the insulating gasket 32 from the original position may cause the side wall of the bus bar 31 to contact with the through hole 21, thereby causing insulation failure. The insulating gasket 32 is bonded to the cover plate 2, so that the insulating gasket 32 is more firmly fixed, and the sealing performance between the insulating gasket 32 and the cover plate 2 is improved to some extent.

Preferably, the bus bar 31 is riveted to the fixing washer 33. Since the insulating gasket 32 is usually made of plastic or other soft materials, it is not preferable to fix the current collector 31 and the fixing gasket 33 by welding, and the riveting connection can not generate heat which can burn the insulating gasket 32, but can press the insulating gasket 32 on the cover plate 2, thereby improving the sealing performance of the battery.

Preferably, the cover plate 2 is further provided with a liquid injection hole 22, and the electrolyte is injected into the battery through the liquid injection hole 22 and infiltrates the core package. Furthermore, the opening position of the liquid injection hole 22 is opposite to the extending direction of the tab of the core bag, so that the core bag can be directly soaked by the electrolyte, and the soaking speed of the core bag by the electrolyte is increased. Of course, the case 1 may be perforated to allow the electrolyte to be injected.

Furthermore, a sealing nail 4 is arranged on the liquid injection hole 22, and the sealing nail 4 is used for plugging the liquid injection hole 22 after liquid injection, so that the electrolyte is prevented from leaking.

In other embodiments, the liquid injection hole 22 functions as the through hole 21 formed in the cover plate 2, so that the number of holes to be punched can be reduced, which is beneficial to simplifying the process, improving the production efficiency and reducing the cost.
